cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: Internal energy U = Σ(KE + PE) of molecules; Temperature ∝ mean KE per molecule

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: Q = mcDeltaθ (no phase change); Q = mL (phase change); L_fusion, L_vaporisation

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: 1st law: DeltaU = Q + W; W = ∫PdV (work done ON gas); Q +ve into system, W +ve on system

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: Ideal gas: pV = nRT = NkT; Boyle p∝1/V (isothermal), Charles V∝T (isobaric), Pressure p∝T (isochoric)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: Kinetic theory: pV = ⅓Nm<c^2> -> p = ⅓ρ<c^2>; <c^2> = 3RT/M

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: RMS speed: c_rms = sqrt(3RT/M); M = molar mass in kg/mol

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: Degrees of freedom: monatomic 3 (translational); diatomic 5 (+2 rotational) at room temp

cards.front: Recall a key point about Thermal Physics
cards.back: Equipartition: each quadratic term contributes ½kT per molecule
